requirements.requirement: Implement-1 finding 1 (major): a valid assistant response promotes the record the payload call computed (3.1; §5.1; §5.3 (5))
requirements.evidence: C4 now starts from `recallBlock: "block"` and fires a recalling payload. It asserts `nextCarrier` equals `{index 0, fingerprint "own", block "block"}` and `carrier` is null, then commits and asserts `carrier` equals that record, then runs a handoff that commits null. The two-commits test now promotes two distinct records (`own`, then `later`). I re-ran both mutations: `state.carrier = null` turns 2 tests red (it turned 0 red in round 1), and commit-only-from-null turns the same 2 red.
